raw_text: Building collapsed at 1200 Westheimer Rd. We have about 10 people trapped. Need rescue teams urgently!
Water lines are down in the whole neighborhood near Memorial Park. Hundreds of people without clean water. Please help.
Fire spreading rapidly near the chemical plant on Hwy 225. We need fire trucks, and masks for the smoke.
Send blankets to the makeshift shelter at the high school. It's freezing and we have 50 elderly folks here.
Road washed out on I-45 North. A bus is stuck with 30 passengers. Need medical supplies, some are injured.
